title: Angel Food Candy
description: This crunchy honeycomb candy is dipped in a chocolate coating.

steps.text: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine sugar, corn syrup and vinegar. Cook, stirring, until sugar dissolves. Heat, without stirring, to 300 to 310 degrees F (149 to 154 degrees C), or until a small amount of syrup dropped into cold water forms hard, brittle threads.
Remove from heat and stir in baking soda. Pour into prepared pan; do not spread. (Mixture will not fill pan.) Allow to cool completely.

In the microwave or over a double boiler, melt coating chocolate, stirring frequently until smooth. Break cooled candy into bite-sized pieces and dip into melted candy coating. Let set on waxed paper. Store tightly covered.

video.description: You can make your very own crunchy candy with this impressive chocolate candy recipe. In this video, Annie shows you how to make honeycomb without the honey by using dark corn syrup, white sugar, and vinegar – plus baking soda later on to create those air bubbles. Once cooled, break the honeycomb into pieces and dunk each one into melted chocolate for homemade candies that are delightfully crisp and flakey. This recipe may be a little weird, but it’s so much fun to make!
